parsed.answer: This has been reported before: the Command Palette dock shows ??? for CPU, GPU, RAM and network instead of live values. The main tracking ticket is PowerToys#46216, which is still open and has reports on 0.98 through 0.100.2. PowerToys#46380 was closed as a duplicate of it. There is no confirmed fix yet. The tickets suggest these workarounds. (1) Click each widget in the dock once. One user said this fixed it, though others said it didn't. (2) Disable and re-enable the dock, or restart PowerToys. In one report this didn't help. (3) Try restarting PowerToys as administrator. In PowerToys#46380 this made the stats work. In PowerToys#48680 the problem persisted after a restart even when running as admin, and removing and re-adding the widget or reinstalling didn't help. Please add your 0.100.2 bug report ZIP and your system details to PowerToys#46216 so the maintainers can investigate.
